# Psalm 120 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. To YHWH in-my-distress I-called, and-he-answered-me.

**2** O-YHWH deliver my-soul from-lip-of falsehood, from-tongue-of deceit.

**3** What will-he-give to-you, and-what will-he-add to-you, O-tongue-of deceit?

**4** Arrows-of a-warrior sharpened, with-coals-of broom-tree.

**5** Woe to-me that I-sojourn in-Meshech, that-I-dwell among-tents-of Kedar!

**6** Too-long has-dwelt my-soul with haters-of peace.

**7** I peace, and-when I-speak, they for-war.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **120:1**: First of the Songs of Ascents (shir hamma'alot) — 15 psalms (120-134) likely sung by pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem for festivals.

— EMET
